Chatpata Potato Sandwich

Here’s a guaranteed finger-licking tiffin recipe to give your kids a much-deserved break from the routine of roti sabzi!

5 minPreparation
10 minCooking
4Servings

Ingredients

For 4 servings

Let’s make it.

  1. Preheat sandwich griller.
  2. Place 2 bread slices on a worktop and apply butter and chutney on one side of each slice. Spread the ketchup evenly on top.
  3. Place the vegetables on bread and cover with other bread slices.
  4. Apply little butter on top of the sandwich and place in the griller. Cook till golden and grill marks appear.
  5. Remove from heat and cut into halves. Serve hot with tomato ketchup.
